id: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom (1984)

facts.text: Doctor Jones, no snake surprise for me. I'll take the noodles, you try the dessert.
facts.why: Short Round does not say this. His real lines are about listening to him, and one fits a menu well.
facts.fix: I keep telling you, you listen to me more, you live longer!

fix_note.text: I keep telling you, you listen to me more, you live longer!
